As you will find out shortly most of the ANNs have a very similar general architecture. There are three main layers in such a network. The first one will always be the input layer. This is logical as you cannot process data while it is absent. Following this is the so called hidden layer. This is where the entire processing takes place as the input data is being passed through the net. Within this layer there can be many more layers. Finally we have the output layer which, as the name suggests, returns the output. Each of these layers consists of artificial neurons which are often called nodes.
